fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 19.7 per cent of tertiary graduates in Botswana in 2021, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 19.1 per cent of tertiary graduates in Botswana in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 18.1 per cent of tertiary graduates in Botswana in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 10.9 per cent of tertiary graduates in Botswana in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
